title: Keno Winning Numbers Open Dataset
subtitle: Official Keno catalog metadata — version 2026-08-11
description: Version 2026-08-11 of the Keno Winning Numbers Open Dataset, maintained by Keno Winning Numbers Team. It contains normalized lottery Keno offerings, rules, schedules, operators, regulators, source evidence and verification metadata. The canonical dataset source is https://kenowinningnumbers.com/data. Repository: https://github.com/manuscodex/keno-open-data.
